page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines of title, imprint and date, with a blue rectangle (digitiser's/masking overlay) covering the centre; nothing printed under the overlay is transcribed. Page number "2" in handwriting at top right is not printed and is left out.

main_text.l: Cum Gratia & Privilegio S. Cæs. Majest.

page.notes: The blue rectangle covers the middle of the page (roughly the lines between "tradita" and "Cum Gratia"); it is not printed text, so nothing is transcribed from it. Date "clɔ Iɔ xcVII" is read as MDXCVII (1597). "RODOLPHI" is set in small capitals with the letter forms partly worn; "Methodicè" and "compendiosè" are read with the accents as seen. Scan damage (stains, paper wear) is not printed text and is not transcribed.
